newsitem.title: USA: Grill drops plan to buy Hamburger Hamlets.
newsitem.headline: Grill drops plan to buy Hamburger Hamlets.

text.p: Grill Concepts Inc said it will not proceed with its plans to buy Hamburger Hamlet Restaurants Inc assets but it will continue to explore its alternatives with Hamburger Hamlet.

Grill said it agrees with its financial advisers' view that the valuation for the assets was unrealistic and that conditions of the business, particularly failed cash flow projections, make it difficult to fund with conventional funding sources.

Grill said it will focus on opening additional Daily Grill restaurants. It said its interest in the Hamburger Hamlet assets remains high, and at the request of Hamburger Hamlet it will continue to explore alternatives.
